name: Gorkanaut
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 325 pts for 1 model; 3rd+ unit 355 pts for 1 model.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Gorkanaut model. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_transport_note: Printed as: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ORKS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport GHAZGHKULL THRAKA models. Each MEGA ARMOUR/JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 models.
transportCapacity: 12 ORKS INFANTRY models. Each MEGA ARMOUR or JUMP PACK model counts as 2. It cannot carry GHAZGHKULL THRAKA.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Deffstorm mega-shoota; 2 Dual Big Shoota; 1 Klaw of Gork; 2 Rokkit Launcha; 1 Skorcha.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
